### Part 1: Statement of Facts

1. The arbitration was commenced on 12 May 2026.

### Part 2: Issues

2. Whether the order sought in paragraph 1 of the notice of application should be granted: A stay of execution of the order of Trelawney J. pending the appeal
3. Whether the order sought in paragraph 2 of the notice of application should be granted: An order extending the interim stay of VanIAC arbitration 2767-DCA-EP

### Part 3: Analysis

4. **The appeal raises no serious question to be tried.**

5. The arbitration was commenced on 12 May 2026.

   ```
   The arbitration was commenced on 12 May 2026.
   ```
   > Affidavit #1 of Adrian Renwick, para 4

6. A stay requires a serious question, irreparable harm, and a favourable balance of convenience.

   ```
   the tripartite test
   ```
   > *RJR-MacDonald Inc. v. Canada (Attorney General)*, [1994] 1 SCR 311, at 334

### Part 4: Order(s) Sought

7. The application is dismissed, with costs.
